column1: # The language rules of the keyboard, written by hand, so they live in Git rather
# than in the generated forms.tsv. The keyboard reads this file then forms.tsv.
# A rule is `@name TAB words`, with words separated by spaces. Grammar reads the
# French ones to agree verbs, and the engine reads the last group. A line it does
# not know is skipped, and without this file every rule is simply absent.
# The bits of a form's mask in forms.tsv. tools/pack-grammar.py reads them here.
# What may stand between a subject and its verb.
